Coursedog is hiring a mid-level Software Engineer (no seniority prefix, $70–90k) to work on its academic operations platform for colleges and universities. The role spans both backend services and APIs and the Vue frontend, with ownership of features from scoping through release, including refactoring legacy components. The core stack is TypeScript and modern JavaScript on Node.js with Vue.js, MongoDB, Redis, and relational databases, plus AWS and some exposure to Python, Java, or .NET on the backend.
